SELECT RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, RE.EMP_NAME, RE.CERT_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.CERT_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CERT_TYPE_NAME, RE.CERT_NUMBER, RE.EMP_TELPHONE, RE.EMP_ADDRESS, RE.SEX_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.SEX_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SEX_NAME, RE.NATIONALITY_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.NATIONALITY_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY_NAME, RE.EMP_BIRTHDAY, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,TO_DATE(RE.EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY/MM/DD'))/12) EMP_AGE, RE.FINAL_SCHOOL, RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FINAL_EDU_NAME, RE.FINAL_GRAD_DATE, RE.EMP_EMAIL, RE.POST_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.POST_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_TYPE_NAME, RE.WORK_EXPERIENCE, RE.FILE_PATH, RE.FILE_NAME, RE.REC_TYPE, RE.INTERVIEW_TIME, RE.INTERVIEW_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(RE.CREATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') CREATE_DATE, RE.CREATED_BY, get_local_name_by_personid(RE.CREATED_BY,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) CREATED_NAME, TO_CHAR(RE.UPDATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') UPDATE_DATE, RE.UPDATED_BY, get_local_name_by_personid(RE.UPDATED_BY,#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#) UPDATED_NAME FROM REC_EMPLOYEE RE WHERE RE.ACTIVITY = 1 AND REC_TYPE = 1
UPPER(RE.EMP_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#KEY:VARCHAR#||'%')
RE.POST_TYPE_CODE = #POST_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#
RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE = #FINAL_EDU_CODE:VARCHAR#
order by RE.CREATE_DATE DESC
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO REC_INTERVIEW (REC_INTERVIEW_NO, REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#, #REC_EMPLOYEE_NO:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #createBy:VARCHAR#)

INSERT INTO REC_AFFIRM (REC_AFFIRM_NO, REC_INTERVIEW_NO, AFFIRM_LEVEL, AFFIRMOR_ID, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY) VALUES (REC_AFFIRM_NO_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#, #AFFIRM_LEVEL:VARCHAR#, #AFFIRMOR_ID:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #createBy:VARCHAR#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE REC_EMPLOYEE SET INTERVIEW_TIME = TO_DATE(#INTERVIEW_TIME#,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), INTERVIEW_ADDRESS = #INTERVIEW_ADDRESS:VARCHAR#, REC_TYPE = 3 WHERE REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = #REC_EMPLOYEE_NO:VARCHAR#
